visual_description: A painted clown-girl with devil horns and half-lidded eyes. Blood kisses dot her pale cheeks.
emotional_response: Erotic absurdity. A grin as invitation. Madness becomes desirable.
rational_analysis: Harlequin archetype. Pleasure masked in chaos. The sacred fool made flesh.
existential_reflection: You laughed when you bled. Did it feel like love, when no one else was watching?
